interpretation.scientificTimeoutsUnchanged: The event-group, lane, oracle-batch, instrument, empty-boundary, planner, repair and initialization limits are byte-for-value unchanged from v5.0.
interpretation.hostLifecycleSeparation: Unity startup/validation, measured-mode execution, post-output Burst completion and natural editor exit are separately observed. Host cleanup time is never charged to a measured algorithm interval.
interpretation.runnerOwnedExit: Formal Unity command lines omit -quit. After output freeze and stable Burst completion, the versioned runner is the sole owner of EditorApplication.Exit.
interpretation.operationalReplacementChoice: The scientific stopping contract permits at most one precommitted whole-superblock technical replacement. This executable v5.1 implementation elects the stricter zero-replacement fail-stop policy; it does not expand, weaken, or silently exercise that optional allowance.
interpretation.timeouts: A timeout is a terminal technical failure of the active execution attempt. The supervisor records structural process evidence, sends no signal, and never authorizes retry, resume, top-up, merge, skip, reorder or parallel completion.
interpretation.targetHostRecheck: All resource limits and free-space requirements must be rechecked before any later collection authorization.
